WHAT YOU CAN DO

Good plans. Great company.

From the first “anyone keen?” to the photos you’ll keep.

01

Find your next thing

Browse activities by cost, time and group size. Save a favourite for later.

02

03

Keep the good bits

EARLY ACCESS / ANDROID

Try SideQuest.

Bring your people.

Sign in with Google or email, then create a private group or join one with an invite. Head to Discover for activity ideas and turn one into a plan.

SideQuest uses hosted services for accounts, group data and media. It needs an internet connection. Current notifications are inside the app; these test builds are still being refined.
